8	## Step 1: Technology Discovery
9	
10	### 1. AI-Powered HVAC TAB (Testing Adjusting Balancing) Automation
11	- **Domain**: Commercial HVAC commissioning
12	- **Breakthrough**: Wireless multi-sensor airflow measurement (Evergreen Telemetry Wrist Reporter, Testo 405i Bluetooth) combined with AI-driven automatic balancing calculations, eliminating iterative manual duct-by-duct adjustments
13	- **TRL**: 7 (Evergreen Telemetry shipping since 2010, wireless sensors proven, AI balancing algorithms demonstrated)
14	- **Time to product**: 6-9 months
15	- **Status**: PROMOTED
16	- **Reasoning**: TAB is a $6.2B market, heavily manual (paper forms, 2-person teams), severe technician shortage (110K gap). A software platform that ingests wireless sensor data and auto-generates balancing instructions could reduce a 2-person, 3-day job to 1-person, 1-day. Low hardware cost (commodity Bluetooth sensors), high software margin.
17	
18	### 2. Elevator Predictive Maintenance for Independent Service Companies
19	- **Domain**: Vertical transportation maintenance
20	- **Breakthrough**: Low-cost vibration/accelerometer IoT nodes with edge ML for ride-quality degradation and fault prediction, targeting independent service providers who lack OEM telemetry
21	- **TRL**: 7 (Uptime.ac deployed at scale in Europe, Smart Lifts in Singapore, Elevate Tech operational)
22	- **Time to product**: 9-12 months
23	- **Status**: REJECTED
24	- **Reasoning**: Competitive density is HIGH. Uptime.ac ($20M raised, 6000 customers), SafeLine Lyra (4000 units deployed), DATOMS, Elevate Tech, plus KONE/Otis/Schindler all have proprietary solutions. Market already has 5+ funded players.
25	
26	### 3. Automated Parking Structure Condition Assessment
27	- **Domain**: Infrastructure inspection
28	- **Breakthrough**: Drone-mounted GPR + AI interpretation for rapid concrete deterioration mapping without lane closures; Birdsview (Norway) demonstrates sub-minute rebar analysis from GPR data
29	- **TRL**: 6-7 (Infrasense doing GPR since 1987, Birdsview AI proven, DroneDeploy commercial drones established)
30	- **Time to product**: 12-18 months
31	- **Status**: PROMOTED
32	- **Reasoning**: Parking structures require inspection every 3-5 years (IBC code). Current assessment is expensive manual engineering ($5-15/sq ft). AI-automated GPR interpretation could reduce cost 80%. Infrasense is a small ($1-10M) consulting firm, not a scalable software company. Birdsview is Norway-focused on new construction. Gap exists for US parking-specific automated assessment.
33	
34	### 4. Continuous Roof Membrane Leak Detection (Permanent Monitoring)
35	- **Domain**: Commercial roofing
36	- **Breakthrough**: Permanently embedded capacitance/impedance sensor grids with wireless cloud monitoring for real-time leak detection on flat commercial roofs
37	- **TRL**: 8 (Detec PermaScan, SMT Research FutureCast, Sentinel Roof Technologies all shipping)
38	- **Time to product**: 6-9 months
39	- **Status**: REJECTED
40	- **Reasoning**: Competitive density is HIGH. At least 6 established players: ILD (since 2001, global), Detec/PermaScan (permanent monitoring), SMT Research (FutureCast), Sentinel Roof Technologies, Honza Group (since 2005), Tector System. The $1.2B market is already well-served. No meaningful differentiation angle available.
41	
42	### 5. Building Envelope Thermography AI (Drone-Based)
43	- **Domain**: Building diagnostics / energy efficiency
44	- **Breakthrough**: AI analysis of drone-captured thermal imagery to automatically identify insulation gaps, air leakage paths, moisture intrusion, and window seal failures
45	- **TRL**: 7 (Lamarr.AI shipping, Inspekt AI operational, AERIALLY.AI launched 2024)
46	- **Time to product**: 6-9 months
47	- **Status**: REJECTED
48	- **Reasoning**: Competitive density is HIGH. Lamarr.AI ($1.1M pre-seed, MIT spinout), Inspekt AI (2022), ThermoLabs, AERIALLY.AI (2024), SkyVisor, Therm-A.I, Averroes.ai - at least 7 players already in this space. The $1.46B market has attracted multiple funded startups and the space is crowded.
49	
50	### 6. HVAC Fault Detection for Small/Medium Commercial Buildings (No BMS Required)
51	- **Domain**: Building energy optimization
52	- **Breakthrough**: AI-powered HVAC fault detection using only utility meter data and cheap IoT temperature/humidity sensors, without requiring a building management system - targeting the 90% of commercial buildings under 50,000 sq ft that lack BMS
53	- **TRL**: 6-7 (SensGreen deploys edge AI on Raspberry Pi, LeanFM Prescriptiv operational)
54	- **Time to product**: 9-12 months
55	- **Status**: PROMOTED

A sensor-light approach (3-5 wireless sensors + utility data + weather API) could serve 10x more buildings. SensGreen is Turkey-based and early; LeanFM has only $605K funding and 7 employees. Gap exists for US-focused, BMS-free HVAC waste detection.

59	- **Domain**: Vertical transportation
60	- **Breakthrough**: Non-invasive vibration/acoustic sensors with ML for predicting handrail, step chain, and drive unit failures on escalators
61	- **TRL**: 7 (SafeLine Lyra deployed 4000 units, OxMaint operational, KONE has IoT platform)
62	- **Time to product**: 9-12 months
63	- **Status**: REJECTED

68	- **Breakthrough**: Deep learning models achieving 97%+ accuracy on GPR scan interpretation for rebar location, diameter, cover depth, and corrosion detection - replacing expensive manual interpretation by specialized engineers
69	- **TRL**: 7 (Birdsview shipping, GeoRadar AI operational, academic models validated)
70	- **Time to product**: 9-12 months

A US-focused SaaS that takes raw GPR files and returns instant structural reports could serve thousands of engineering firms. Low competitive density (2 players, both small/international).

76	- **Breakthrough**: Mobile-first platform that pairs with any Bluetooth airflow instrument, auto-logs readings by location (using floor plan recognition), generates NEBB/AABC-compliant reports automatically, and flags out-of-spec readings with correction recommendations
77	- **TRL**: 8 (BuildingStart exists since 2006 but is outdated with $580K revenue; CxPlanner exists for commissioning broadly)
78	- **Time to product**: 4-6 months

82	### 10. Automated Commercial Building Energy Audit SaaS
83	- **Domain**: Energy efficiency / compliance
84	- **Breakthrough**: AI platform that performs ASHRAE Level II energy audits using utility bills, weather data, building metadata, and minimal IoT sensors - replacing $15-50K manual audits with $2-5K automated reports
85	- **TRL**: 6-7 (NexEnergyAudit.ai, Enersee.ai both operational)
86	- **Time to product**: 9-12 months

88	- **Reasoning**: Multiple players already emerging: NexEnergyAudit.ai (ASHRAE 211 compliant), Enersee.ai (portfolio-scale), SparkZ3R0. Additionally, the big FDD platforms (BrainBox AI, CIM, Clockworks) all offer energy analysis. Building energy audit regulations vary by city/state creating fragmented compliance needs. Not capital-efficient enough given competition.

92	## Step 2: Competitive Analysis
93	
94	### AI-Powered HVAC TAB Automation
95	- **Competitors found**: 75F (dynamic airflow balancing, $81.3M raised - but targets building automation not TAB services), Evergreen Telemetry (wireless TAB instruments, $3M revenue, hardware only - no AI), Distech Controls/myDC AirBalancing (VAV calibration app - limited to their own controllers), Flair (residential only), Zonex ($4.7-6.1M revenue, hardware dampers not software)
96	- **Competitive density score**: 2/5
97	- **Differentiation angle**: None of these are an AI-driven TAB workflow automation platform. 75F is building automation (permanent install), not TAB services. Evergreen makes instruments but no software platform. The gap is: take wireless sensor readings + building design specs + AI optimization = auto-calculated damper settings and balancing sequence. This replaces the iterative trial-and-error that takes TAB technicians 2-5 days per project.
98	- **Status**: PROMOTED
99	- **Reasoning**: No direct competitor offers AI-powered TAB workflow optimization. The adjacent players are either hardware-only (Evergreen, Zonex) or permanent building automation (75F, BrainBox). TAB is a distinct professional service with specific workflow needs unmet by existing tools.

101	### Automated Parking Structure Condition Assessment
102	- **Competitors found**: Infrasense (established 1987, $1-10M revenue, manual GPR interpretation), Bridgology (GPR + LiDAR, consulting firm), GPR Data (consulting services), DroneDeploy (generic drone platform, not parking-specific), Benesch (engineering firm offering thermal drone), Geobility Systems (one-off projects)
103	- **Competitive density score**: 3/5
104	- **Differentiation angle**: All current players are consulting/service firms doing manual analysis. None offer a scalable software product that property managers can subscribe to for regular automated assessments. However, the sales cycle for infrastructure inspection is long (property managers, engineering firms) and the market may be too niche.

- **The pain:** A TAB technician walks a building taking hundreds of airflow / static-pressure / temperature readings at diffusers, grilles, VAV boxes, and AHUs, comparing each to the engineer's design CFM, then iteratively adjusting dampers. Historically this is recorded on **paper field sheets or Excel**, re-keyed back at the office into NEBB/AABC-format report templates — a documentation step estimated at **15–25% of project labor** (ASSUMED, from cycle-026).
